basic_details.job_title: ABDM Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 20 Project Manager, Business Analyst and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Lead of Data Science & AI, Emerging Technology, PMO & Delivery Head, Lead of Engineering (Front-End & Experience) and 16 more
basic_details.short_information: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), State Health Society, Maharashtra, Mumbai has invited applications for 20 posts in 19 roles. The posts include Lead of Data Science & AI, Emerging Technology, PMO & Delivery Head, Lead of Engineering (Front-End & Experience), Lead of Engineering (Backend & Data Platforms) and 15 more. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 17 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand draft / cheque of a nationalised bank in favour of STATE HEALTH SOCIETY MAHARASHTRA - OTHERS; non-refundable.

qualification.education_qualification: Technical posts: B.E./B.Tech in CS/IT/EE or MCA with 4 to 10 years of IT experience, or Any Graduate with 7 to 13 years of experience (MBA Graduate for Project Manager). Non-technical posts: engineering degree, MCA, MBA/PGDM, Master's (Public Health, Public Policy, Social Sciences etc.), LLB/LLM or MBBS/BDS with 3 to 10+ years of experience, as per post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 3,25,157, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Attend the walk-in at 8th Floor, Arogya Bhavan, Mumbai at 10.00 AM: Sr. No. 1 to 14 on 17-11-2026, Sr. No. 15 to 19 on 18-11-2026.
Bring the application in the prescribed format with self-attested copies of documents and all originals.
Attach a nationalised bank demand draft / cheque for the application fee in favour of STATE HEALTH SOCIETY MAHARASHTRA - OTHERS.
Arrange documents 1 to 9 in order as listed in the notice.
Register your name at the office, then appear for document scrutiny and the interview.
important_instructions: Walk-in originally set for 03-11-2026 and 04-11-2026 was postponed owing to technical difficulties and rescheduled No travelling allowance or other allowance for attending the recruitment process Number of posts, place and remuneration may change Candidates cannot ask for a change of posting place Applications without a proper demand draft / cheque will not be considered

content_sections.text: Purely contractual, initially for three years from the date of joining, subject to annual performance Annual increase of 10% in consolidated remuneration based on annual performance evaluation Services end automatically if the ABDM project closes or funds are not approved One month's notice, or one month's pay, to resign No right to claim absorption into regular Government service, NHM or Public Health Department Must execute the prescribed agreement

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ABDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ABDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies: 1 Lead of Data Science & AI, Emerging Technology, 1 PMO & Delivery Head, 1 Lead of Engineering (Front-End & Experience), 1 Lead of Engineering (Backend & Data Platforms), 1 Chief Architect (Strategy & Solution), 1 Lead SRE & System Availability and 13 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ABDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Open category: Rs.750. Reserved category: Rs.500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 years to 60 years (NHA Norm).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹ 3,25,157 for Lead of Data Science & AI, Emerging Technology, ₹ 2,94,773 for PMO & Delivery Head, ₹ 2,94,773 for Lead of Engineering (Front-End & Experience), ₹ 2,94,773 for Lead of Engineering (Backend & Data Platforms), ₹ 3,25,157 for Chief Architect (Strategy & Solution).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Technical posts: B.E./B.Tech in CS/IT/EE or MCA with 4 to 10 years of IT experience, or Any Graduate with 7 to 13 years of experience (MBA Graduate for Project Manager). Non-technical posts: engineering degree, MCA, MBA/PGDM, Master's (Public Health, Public Policy, Social Sciences etc.), LLB/LLM or MBBS/BDS with 3 to 10+ years of experience, as per post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Physically and mentally fit for the post. No criminal case filed against the applicant. No departmental inquiry pending or proposed against the applicant. Candidates working at more than one place should not apply.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with more than two living children from 23-07-2020 (small family condition). Candidates absent on the interview day; applications received after that day are not accepted.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Registration at the venue. Scrutiny of original documents by a scrutiny committee. Walk-in interview (50 marks). Interview marks: Subject Knowledge 10, Research & Academic Knowledge 10, Leadership Quality 10, Administrative Ability 10, Experience 10; total 50.
